statement: Let n = len(heights). For 0-based inclusive indices 0 <= i <= j < n, let m(i,j) = min { heights[k] | i <= k <= j } and let area(i,j) = m(i,j) * (j - i + 1). The function returns a result r and r = max { area(i,j) | 0 <= i <= j < n }.
